IndustrialVisit.title: Industrial Visit
descriptions: Welcome to the most interactive and happening cell of Nagarjuna Degree College – “Industry Institution Integration Cell”!!! The IIIC is the brainchild of the fundamental philosophy of our respected Principal Dr. Harish Babu S.

As part of this cell, we have a strong commitment to provide 1-3 Industrial visits per semester. With this commitment we have already visited the facilities of various prestigious companies like UNIBIC, KS&DL (Mysore Sandal Factory), Akshaya Patra Foundations and many other Government, Public and Private companies including both manufacturing and service sectors. Also, we have provision for installing incubation centers and various office facilities at our campus as part of IIIC.
